title: Plastic Shock: You eat a credit card every week
hook: EAT A CREDIT CARD EVERY WEEK?
script:
You swallow a credit card's worth of plastic every single week.
Think that's impossible?
Microplastics are everywhere.
In your food.
In your water.
Even the air you breathe.
We consume 5 grams weekly.
That's like eating a full credit card.
From synthetic clothes.
To tire dust and packaging.
These particles cause inflammation.
They disrupt gut health.
Linked to various diseases.
Are we accepting this fate?
Reducing single-use plastics helps.
Filtering your water.
But can you escape it?
This plastic cycle is global.
It's raining plastic worldwide.
Is a credit card's worth of plastic really what you want for dinner?
comment: How much plastic do you think is in your body right now?
description: The shocking truth about microplastic consumption. You're likely eating more plastic than you think, with serious health implications. #Microplastics #HealthFacts #HiddenDangers
